name: ShopConnect
author: Michael

sections.description:
ShopConnect allows you to have a product list, product detail page and a shopping cart with your Shopify products inside of your WordPress. The checkout, customer data and all products are still managed in Shopify.

Current features:
* list of products
* product detail pages with a template you can customize
* cart menu on the side (visible once it contains a product)
* product sync every two hours
* custom permalinks for /products/ and /collections/
* metafield support

Check the help section for all available shortcodes (product title, image, description, price, buy button, metafield, text input) and properties.

Note:
* currently there is no pagination so for better performance only use it for smaller shops with a few products.
* to style your products and lists you’ll have to use your own custom CSS.
* check “ShopConnect – Help” how to setup the connection.

External services

This plugin connects to the Shopify API to fetch the products and will display image with Shopify URLs. If you enable “Prefetch API” in the plugin settings it will also add prefetch links to your header.
This service is provided by “Shopify Inc.”: terms of use (https://www.shopify.com/de/legal/api-terms), privacy policy (https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy).
sections.installation:
• You will need to have a Shopify shop and get a Storefront Token. Check ShopConnect – Help how to setup and connect the plugin to your Shopify shop.
  • After that you can insert the ShopConnect shortcodes to get a product list page and adjust the “Product Details Page” template to setup the detail page look.
